text:
maria: wrapping up my shift — leaving handoff notes and a few follow-ups from the postmortem (INC-2024-07). main risk: token cache leak regression on v2.2 that can cause elevated memory growth on long-lived streams. checked status and left tickets below. :spiral_calendar_pad:

maria: quick summary:
- mitigation in place: autoscaler downscales pods at 70% mem, rate limit for long-running streams applied.
- fixes deployed yesterday (canary -> prod) but need verification on edge cases (kv-cache eviction).
- outstanding remediation tickets: RH-512, RH-523, RH-531.

maria: commands I used to verify the rollout (if you want to re-run):

```bash
kubectl -n inference-prod get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
kubectl -n inference-prod logs deploy/runtime-canary --since=2h | grep "kv-cache evict"
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-inference-runtime -n inference-prod
```

jonathan: thanks — I can run a quick smoke tomorrow morning. which test corpus did you use for long streams?

maria: used tst-longstreams-v3 (in S3: s3://redwood-evals/longstreams/tst-longstreams-v3.tar.gz). reproduces memory climb ~95% of the time with the old image.

sasha: RH-523 is my ticket (kv eviction algorithm). I pushed a change to remove a subtle race; it's on prod-canary at sha: ab12f3c. I ran the unit/e2e subset but didn't soak for >4h. please do a longer soak.

lee: pinging @jonathan and @tariq — if one of you can run a 6h soak on canary with the longstreams corpus, validate memory and logs (search for "kv-cache evict" and "cache miss ratio"). I can schedule infra to keep an extra node on standby if we see churn.

jonathan: I can start tonight at 23:00 PDT and run for 6h. will post results in this thread.

tariq: FYI I triaged RH-512 (alert noise around the autoscaler) — reduced sensitivity and added a 3m cooldown. should reduce unnecessary scale-down churn.

maria: thanks. for context RH-531 is the postmortem action to add a regression test into CI. it's low risk but must be on the 2-week sprint. @sasha can you add a smoke test that runs a short sequence of long-stream tokens?

sasha: on it — I'll add a minimal integration test and link RH-531. ETA: end of day Thursday.

oncall-bot: reminder: handoff checklist incomplete: please confirm that at least one long-soak was run and RH-523/RH-512 updated before next handoff.

maria: leaving contact info: pager on during my commute until 23:30 PDT. if anything urgent ping oncall or DM.

jonathan: starting soak now. I'll paste logs and a quick summary once done.

lee: noted. I'll watch infra for spikes and keep standby node ready.

maria: thanks everyone — handing off to @jonathan. :thumbsup:
